mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 months) over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 5.0% and declining consumer demand (RSAFS YoY growth < 0.5%) signal contractionary monetary policy impacting consumption, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting both conditions over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 102.0 during late-cycle expansion signals supply chain stress that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained residential construction permits above 1350.0 signal strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1350.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits falling below 1300.0 for two consecutive months signal housing market weakness that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1300.0 for 2 months) over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) combined with weak consumer demand (RSAFS YoY growth < 0.5%) signals dual economic stress that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting both conditions over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increasing by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.
